_source: Barro Kitchens - Standard Price List, effective Nov 19, 2026. Amounts are Philippine pesos, excluding VAT.
_readme: The ONLY place a peso amount may enter the public catalogue (owner ruling 2026-11-19, which replaces the 2026-10-21 ruling R1 'no prices anywhere' for /catalogue/ only: the homepage and every other public page stay price-free). Each card of /catalogue/ shows ONE line: 'From' + a peso amount + '+ VAT' (the lowest standard amount of its family, taken from the list named in _source) or 'Priced per project' when the list has no matching row. Keys are the card ids: a configurable family id (scripts/public-families.json), a fixed product id (the master's) or a project card id (scripts/catalogue-cards.js). scripts/build-catalogue.js reads this file, refuses an entry that is not a card of the page and a card that has no entry here, and prints each amount ONLY in the exact from-price element; every other string of the page is still scanned for money. Amounts never come from the private products-database.json. 'from' is a whole number of pesos (no formula, no per-metre rate, no per-size list) and it is the only figure kept here, because this file is public; 'note' says which row of the list it is, for the staff who maintain the file, and is never printed.

prep_table.note: Preparation table, 2 tier, 900 mm: the lowest row of the list

sink.note: Single sink table. The hand sink is not part of the Sink family; larger sink tables are higher

dish_table.note: No dish table row in the list

hood.note: Rear-pitch hood, 0.9 mm body, baffle filters, 1.2 m: the lowest size

stove.note: Low-pressure stove. The stock pot burner is absorbed by this family but is a different, lower item on the list: owner to confirm which figure the card shows

cooking_line.note: Griddle: the lowest row of the family (fryers and lava rock grillers are higher)

deck_oven.note: The list has a pugon pandesal oven but it is not clearly this deck oven: owner to confirm the match

CE-031.note: Spoon and fork heater: no list row

cabinet.note: Wall cabinet: the Cabinet family covers floor and wall cabinets, so the lower row

rack.note: Storage rack. Tabletop dish racks are a different item

noodle_boiler.note: Noodle boiler, 6 baskets, without baskets (with baskets is higher)

combi_stove.note: Combi stove, 1800: 2 burners + griddle + fryer, oven under the burners

station.note: Multi-purpose kitchen station: no list row

exhaust.note: Exhaust and fresh-air ventilation: per project
